latest.author: shanemsink-hub
latest.text: I love it, it's the only thing like it out there. I wonder if we could make it so instead of just showing the view where it shows the cases/box art, if you could create more of a cover flow look, and is it possible to run that in full screen? Other than that minor improvement, I can't complain, it's boss.

latest.author: Phosarite
latest.text: This is the best games launcher/ menu replacement I can find. Theres also not very many options. It desperately needs a ui and file management update. It reads some dlc and updates/ some other files as games and homebrew so you end up with a bunch of random icons pretending to be your games. Also the icons/ game cases look very bad. Low effort "cases" are just box art png with "ps5" or "gc" written on the top on colored stripe. Box art is low quality often.

latest.author: skipperbent
latest.text: I really like the idea but i feel like it needs some polish to make it a proper replacement to the default homescreen. Some titles are using the file name of the game and some covers are extremely low resolution out of the box and worst of all i cannot set a picture of my dog as the background 😭. It has cool features like launching back into the media center when you exit a game. This app could be the xbox 360's aurora of the ps5 so definitely worth installing and keeping an eye out for ☺️👍 hon…

latest.text: Could you add the option for the user to choose which type of application to select for an installed application? Because some applications are mistakenly labeled as homebrew or games, when in fact their purpose is different, and this confuses and mixes things up
